payload.title: Finance categories and finance events encode the owning module inside a hand-written ledger scope (FARM_OPEX, FARM_REVENUE, HR_EXPENSE) kept in copies that disagree, uniqueness is keyed on it, and the farm delete handler fabricates FARM_OPEX when its category lookup misses
evidence: apps/farm-service/src/finance/entities/finance-category.entity.ts:37-40 (FinanceCategoryScope bakes the module prefix into a ledger label; two values)
apps/farm-service/src/finance/entities/finance-category.entity.ts:98-104 (scope is a NOT NULL column with its own Postgres enum)
apps/farm-service/src/database/migrations/1804600000000-CreateFinanceTables.ts:160-168 (code and name uniqueness keyed by tenantId + scope)
libs/event-contracts/src/finance-events.ts:38 (the event union is a wider copy that adds HR_EXPENSE)
apps/hr-service/src/finance/handlers/hr-finance-entry.handlers.ts:106 (hr-service publishes HR_EXPENSE on the same finance event contract)
apps/farm-service/src/finance/handlers/delete-finance-entry.handler.ts:58 (category?.scope ?? 'FARM_OPEX' invents a scope instead of failing)
payload.rule_violated: Module ownership is declared once, in the PKG-01 module dictionary (one concept, one owner), and the repo rule bans defensive optional chaining and fallbacks
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-15, release R8.
